# Refstream.js browser build

Vendored from [`refstream.js` v0.1.0-alpha.2](https://github.com/TeoSlayer/refstream.js/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha.2), commit `1f69436ab7f08e1164143f113c759c54303ffff4`.

The release archive SHA-256 is `b32d0cff498f4d46c8339a5d1d288838f3bb50738bb407658be95ccf749fec8e`. The browser terminal and optional UI modules, their chunks and source maps, stylesheets, and license are retained here. Agent pairing and backed-file transports are intentionally not mounted: shell.online owns its relay, encryption, permissions, and collaboration lifecycle.
